Some clean up and verification that data is correct in datasets in generic / template report will be done before copy to Bathroom planner space is performed.

Define context for measured data

Several aspects:

The metric source aka consumer_id: should be bathroomplanner

target_environment: 'production' should be used for production environment but other environments can be defined as whished by team. It will then be possible to look at DORA metrics for environments in Bathroom planner report.

144 incomplete add GitHub action to pipelines so that we collect data for all relevant environments 145 complete Book follow up meeting where we will verify data 146 complete Book devops team workshop to clean up databricks and PowerBI datasets. Naming convention and redundant columns e t c.


Metric source id vs DEXF consumer id



Initial ambition was to align metric source id with DEXF consumer ids and how data is pushed to Insights. Since it is different contexts it is better perhaps leave metrics source id freed to choose and define how to provide keys that enable relating DORA metrics to insights data.

147 complete align with dexf and book devops team workshop to figure out implementation details

Add repository as extra metadata to data points

Suggestion came up to add repository name as metadata to data points. One benefit would be to more easily verify data.
